name: Scrambled Eggs with Sweetbreads
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: 1 sweetbread, parboiled and cut in dice

steps: Beat eggs slightly, using a silver folk, add salt, pepper, milk, and sweetbread.
Put butter in hot chafing-dish; when melted, pour in the mixture.
Cook until of creamy consistency, constantly stirring and scraping from bottom of the pan.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
